hero:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: actual game animation sprite atlas, fully transparent. Use the attached atlas only as reference for the HERO in its top row. Draw ONLY that same black-haired Korean young adult hero: white rolled-sleeve shirt, loose short red tie, navy trousers, white sneakers, confident face, compact 2.5-head proportions, thick crisp navy outlines and warm clean cel shading. No enemies. Exact uniform 4 columns x 4 rows, sixteen evenly-sized square cells, 2048 square composition. One whole-body hero per cell. Every cell has same camera orthographic front-right three-quarter game view, exact same body size and identity, feet baseline at 88% down the cell, torso horizontally aligned at cell center. All sprites face screen-right. 15% clear transparent margins, no cropping, no overlap across cells, no shadows, no text, no numbers, no grid. Transparent background mandatory.
Animation layout in READING ORDER:
Cells 0-7 (first two rows): eight successive frames of ONE smooth full walking cycle. Clearly alternating legs and opposite arm swing, flexed knees, foot contact, passing and lift poses. Frame0 right foot contacts forward left foot back; frame1 weight settles knees bend; frame2 left leg passes under body; frame3 left knee lifts; frame4 left foot contacts forward right foot back; frame5 weight settles; frame6 right leg passes under body; frame7 right knee lifts to return to frame0. Torso remains consistent, subtle bob only. These must read as incremental motion, not unrelated poses.
Cells8-15 (last two rows): eight successive frames of ONE strong straight punch animation: cell8 balanced fists-up idle/guard, cell9 knees bend and fist pulls back anticipation, cell10 torso coils and rear heel lifts, cell11 punch accelerates arm halfway out, cell12 fully extended punch to right (keep entire fist INSIDE cell), cell13 weight follows through with slight lean, cell14 arm retracts halfway with torso returning, cell15 settles into guard matching cell8. Small believable torso rotation and leg bracing. No drawn energy effects or trails (effects will be rendered in engine).
Polished consistent production sprite animation. Full body every frame, SAME size. No extra sprites.
enemies:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D game walking-animation atlas on genuine transparent background, EXACTLY 4 columns x 4 rows, sixteen square cells, 2048 square composition, no text, no labels, no grid. Use attached reference atlas BOTTOM ROW enemies as character design reference. Same compact 2.5-head proportions, crisp thick navy outlines, warm cel shading, front-right three-quarter orthographic game view, whole body, all face screen-right. Each frame same camera, size and aligned torso, ground baseline at 88% down its own cell. Keep all art fully inside each cell with 15% transparent padding, no floor shadows.
First 8 cells (first two rows): eight successive smooth walking frames of the SAME slim orange-jacket red-brown short-haired street thug from reference, white undershirt, navy pants, white sneakers, fists in fighting guard while walking.
Last 8 cells (last two rows): eight successive smooth walking frames of SAME stocky buzzcut bruiser in purple striped tracksuit from reference, white sneakers, thick eyebrows, fists held up while walking.
Each eight-frame cycle: right foot forward contact, weight settle, left leg passing, left knee lift, left foot forward contact, weight settle, right leg passing, right knee lift returning to first. Clear incremental alternating leg articulation and arm counterbalance, feet lift off ground, not sixteen repeated idle poses. Consistent character identity and proportions throughout. Transparent background, no effects, no weapons, no blood. Sprite sheet only, all 16 cells occupied by exactly one character each.
icons: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production mobile brawler game UI icon atlas. Exactly 2 columns x 2 rows, four equal square cells, square canvas, fully transparent background. Each cell contains one large crisply drawn standalone ability illustration centered with 15% transparent margin, NOT text, NOT numbered, NO UI frame, NO background rectangles or circles. Thick dark navy outline, polished bold cel shading, warm cream / coral orange / amber gold / mint accents. Readable at 64 pixels. Same original Korean neighborhood comic brawler aesthetic across all icons. Top left: white rolled-sleeve forearm and clenched fist smashing into a small red brick wall, orange impact burst and a few brick pieces. Top right: two stylized tough street thug bust silhouettes being knocked into each other, dynamic mint directional chain trail and cream impact spark, orange jacket and purple jacket. Bottom left: expressive stunned street thug head with three golden stars orbiting above, small spiral eyes, purple accent. Bottom right: powerful clenched fist angled upward-right, white wrist wrap, dramatic orange and gold sweeping energy arc and cream speed sparks; an ultimate move icon. No blood, no weapons, no existing game logos or characters. Equal consistent visual weight and icon scale. All artwork entirely inside own cell, no overlap, no captions. Genuine alpha transparency.
